decision.expected_measurable_effect: In a complete simulation with holding_tip_speed_weight changed 0.0 -> 0.01, the primary expected measurable effect is a reduction in sampled holding-window tip speed relative to the baseline window (baseline speed_m_s range 0.635173-1.581015 m/s, limit 0.02 m/s), and a possible secondary reduction in sampled late-window position error (baseline max 0.0581381 m vs limit 0.01 m), with terminal reach expected to remain passing (baseline terminal_error_m 0.00764261 m vs reach_tolerance_m 0.01 m). Computation-side measurements (deadline_misses, Solve_Succeeded/User_Requested_Stop counts, per-update solve and wall times) are watched but not expected to be the treatment benefit. Comparison is against measured baseline reach/holding/computation endpoints only, never against raw scalar objective values across weights, and any reported comparison covers selected rows, not the whole trajectory.
decision.rationale: Hypothesis (bounded, single-variable test of the accepted diagnosis's 'possible' residual-tip-speed hypothesis): the baseline recipe leaves holding_tip_speed_weight at 0.0 (f633d6b86e119), so the optimizer carries no penalty on tip speed at nodes inside the configured settling window; the sampled holding window then shows residual tip speed (0.635173-1.581015 m/s, s = f78dabd8c8235/fdd8ee8afdf0d) far above speed_limit_m_s 0.02 (f5c0ff5680b58) and holding position error up to 0.0581381 m (fc5aed31ccc41) above position_limit_m 0.01 (fabec6428bae8), with holding_speed_passed = false (f95aa741050f1) and holding_position_passed = false (f81cf29aebe30). Relevance: this is the editable term that is scheduled on the holding window itself, i.e. exactly the region where both sampled failures were recorded (f69c083ab366d window_s 0.05, f2352e6338bcb sample_times_s 0.30-0.35). Setting it to a small positive probe value 0.01 supplies an integration-step-weighted spatial speed cost at scheduled holding nodes; terminal_tip_speed_weight is deliberately left at 0.0 (f2032318339b5) so any observed change is not confounded across two weights. Scale (tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02, f22737f2107a8) and holding-node scheduling are unchanged; terminal speed cost remains a single terminal scaled squared-speed term. Expected effects stated separately - reach: terminal_error_m 0.00764261 m currently sits inside reach_tolerance_m 0.01 (f58eda76ea2c8, f2b4ef4a321f5), so reach_passed = true (fe8da39ca02a9) is expected to hold, but the added holding speed cost can perturb the final approach and is a genuine risk to the reach margin. Holding position: effect is indirect (the term penalizes speed, not position); it may suppress overshoot/oscillation that inflates late-window error, but could also increase lag and leave error above 0.01 m. Holding speed: primary intended target; expect sampled holding-window speed to fall relative to baseline toward the 0.02 m/s criterion. Computation: adding a nonzero cost term can change solver conditioning, selected iteration and wall time; baseline already reports deadline_misses 35 (f40b7c1486430), Solve_Succeeded 1 / User_Requested_Stop 34 (fe1f44408b02f, fc52eb2019e4c) and mean_update_s 17.2633 s (fb8eadeb9fd64) against control_period_s 0.01 s (fc080a63d2e09), so this is an adverse-effect watch item rather than an expected benefit. Possible adverse effects: degraded reach margin, no holding-speed reduction, or worse solve/wall time and deadline-miss behaviour. Observations that would weaken the hypothesis: sampled holding-window speed remaining near the baseline 0.6-1.6 m/s despite the positive weight; reach beginning to fail (terminal_error_m >= 0.01 m); or materially worse per-update computation without any holding-speed gain. Provenance and limits: this is a bounded, non-causal improvement intent derived from the accepted diagnosis; an unproven causal mechanism is not required for the bounded experiment, but a single execution plus configuration values do not establish cause, and full warm plans / optimizer iteration traces are not retained. Raw scalar objective values are not compared across weights; only measured reach, holding-position, holding-speed and computation endpoints are compared at the same coverage as the baseline. No local paired comparison is requested because no displayed saved update has an effective plan horizon of 0.01 s (displayed effective_horizon values are 4, 9 and 10 control intervals: fe2fc6f5398a5, fe79be685385a, fe49299a5134a), so a legal comparison state cannot be identified from current evidence.
